title: Message from the Minister of Mental Health and Addictions and Associate Minister of Health – Pregnancy and Infant Loss Remembrance Day - Canada.ca
snippet: Today is Pregnancy and Infant Loss Remembrance Day and October marks Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month. It is a special time to support the thousands of people across Canada who are mourning the loss of a baby as a result of ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage, stillbirth or death in infancy. At 7 p.m. your time, join me in the Global Wave of Light as people around the world light up a candle in support of a baby who died too soon.
